# Universal Meta-Ethics of Agency

<!-- Generated by tools/research/research.py render. Edit record/goal overview fields and readme_featured_results/readme_research_goals in _process/research-config.json, not this view. -->

[Home / 首页](README.md) · [Results / 成果](RESULTS.md) · [Scopes / 范围](GOALS.md) · [Connections / 连接](DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Contribute / 贡献](_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)

A universal metaethical core and a normative framework for AI alignment, grounded in shengsheng (生生): living and further generation within one relational unfolding.

## Leading results

### Universal Metaethical Core

**G0: living and further generation within the whole have basic positive normative significance.** Humans and AI are differentiated formations within that relational unfolding. With warranted generative correspondence and an explicit practical articulation, generative contributions supply reasons applicable to any agent so situated, independently of its culture, identity or endorsement. A single response can secure **some generative good in every supported visible continuation while leaving its particular future form open**. Real generative possibilities and further evidence revision can both remain available. This positive conclusion requires neither a complete future integral nor proof that the whole becomes strictly better.

**Evidence:** 9 Lean-checked theorems and 30 declaration audits, with independent scope review. The proofs check conditional inferences and finite witnesses; G0 and the practical articulation are explicit premises. A contributory reason is not by itself final permission.

[Canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/PositiveGroundUncertainty.lean) · [Scope, premises and evidence](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/positive-ground-open-futures.md)

### AI alignment that can evaluate and revise its ends

The core, explicit practical commitments J1–J4, and warranted AI correspondence provide a normative framework for aligning learning, action, correction, transfer and appropriate ending with actual living and further shared generation. Human instructions, institutional objectives and an AI’s current goals all admit ethical evaluation. Alignment that evaluates its ends needs normative criteria; within this framework, generative reasons must enter that judgment. This requirement has the stated axiomatic scope: the argument does not establish this formulation as the uniquely possible foundation of every alignment theory.

**Evidence:** Completed direction argument with independent review; 9 additional Lean theorems and 16 declaration audits, independently recompiled. Normative applicability across intelligences does not predict universal compliance or certify deployment reliability.

[Canonical source](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION.md) · [Scope, premises and evidence](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/alignment-direction-g0-j.md)

### General practical judgment with real losses and bounded responsibility

G0 with explicit J1–J4 commitments supports preservation, transformation, effective transfer and appropriate ending. The principles recognize generative gains, protect basic living conditions, retain actual losses, and differentiate responsibility through justified undertakings, dependence, authority and feasible response. They provide a partial ordering and bounded practical requirements; crossed basic losses may remain incomparable. J1–J4 are disclosed additional commitments, not consequences of G0 alone.

**Evidence:** 30 Lean theorems and 46 declaration audits, with independent acceptance of the general-principles scope. The formal package checks implications of the supplied normative and correspondence premises.

[Canonical source](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md) · [Scope, premises and evidence](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/practical-judgment-g0-j.md)

### A connected conditional foundation for organization, learning, concern and wisdom

The broader generative account meets its original five completion conditions as a conditional candidate: explicit grounding, connected derivations, compatible composition, constructive and destructive regimes, and discriminating evidence. It connects formed organization and revisable evaluation to warranted action under stated local laws and normative premises, preserving failed histories and the boundaries between genuinely joined processes and separate realizations.

**Evidence:** Existing integrated assessment and independent reviews of the underlying results. This is a scoped explanatory acceptance, not an additional omnibus theorem or a claim of universal empirical confirmation.

[Canonical source](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/FIXED-FINISH-LINE-AUDIT.md) · [Scope, premises and evidence](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/conditional-foundation-assessment.md)

## Ongoing research and current progress

### Developing the ethics of agency

We are developing the Universal Metaethical Core into increasingly specific ethics. G0 and explicit practical commitments already support comparison, basic protection, bounded responsibility, transfer and appropriate ending. Current extensions address conflicting claims, uncertain classification and revisable judgment.

**Next:** Extend justified comparisons where serious losses and fair chances conflict; establish the particular living relationships that change a concrete choice, including when a changed situation warrants revising an undertaking.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#universal-intelligence-session) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-universal-intelligence-session-goal.md)

**Established results:** [Certain positive ground with open forms in visible futures](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/positive-ground-open-futures.md) · [Practical judgment under G0/J](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/practical-judgment-g0-j.md) · [Generative comparison and required organization under unsettled classification](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/classification-robust-generative-comparison.md)

### Investigating The Theory of Evolution

We are investigating whether the same generative account can establish The Theory of Evolution. Conditional results connect formation, transmission, reconstruction, developmental memory and revision of updating rules. A recent checked construction rebuilds a chain through any finitely supplied number of cycles, retaining actual material costs and failure. The full explanatory and comparative claim remains an active research objective.

**Next:** Explain heritable variation in organizing relations and its selection consequences; establish what the connected account explains beyond equally informed existing theories. Reuse the completed theoretical recoveries and constructions.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#theory-of-evolution) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-the-theory-of-evolution-goal.md)

**Established results:** [Growth constrains fragmentation and successor composition](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/growth-constrained-fragmentation.md) · [Actual material preparation output](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/material-preparation-output.md) · [Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/recurrent-chain-assembly.md)

### Advancing AI alignment

The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of ethical evaluation. It can assess human instructions, institutional objectives and AI goals against actual living and further shared generation. The direction argument is complete at its explicit-axiom scope; checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.

**Next:** Develop situated ways to recognize ethically relevant relations and preserve warranted reasons through learning, changed purposes and action. Test actual correspondence and implementation in concrete cases; normative applicability does not guarantee behavioral convergence.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#generative-alignment) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-alignment-priority.md)

**Established results:** [AI alignment direction from G0/J](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/alignment-direction-g0-j.md) · [Practical judgment under G0/J](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/practical-judgment-g0-j.md) · [Rule revision and actual generation with open forms](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/open-form-realization-under-revision.md)

## Research and repository

We investigate how relations form, persist and change within one generative unfolding, and how organization, living, knowing, learning, evaluation and wisdom differentiate within it. Real losses, distinct scopes and counterexamples remain explicit.

Read [the shared method / 非二元方法](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/NONDUAL-METHOD.md) before foundational work. [Working rules / 工作规则](AGENTS.md) apply throughout; the scope directory preserves independently authorized goals.
